purpose: Provide deterministic, side-effect-free ecosystem component evaluation and recommendation without installation or execution authority.

identity: canonicalize github.com repositories to lowercase owner/repo identity
reject malformed or unsupported non-GitHub sources in Phase A
evidence: separate observed facts from derived scores
preserve explicit unknowns rather than inventing positive evidence
retain evidence references without fetching them inside the pure core
eligibility: refuse forks when policy disallows them
refuse stale repositories beyond policy maxAgeDays
refuse unpinned revisions when pinning is required
refuse unknown licenses when policy requires known license
refuse candidates missing required task capabilities
recommendationReceipt: retain refused candidates and explicit reasons

negativeTests: unknown-license candidate is ineligible when required
unpinned candidate is ineligible when required
duplicate repo identities do not produce duplicate ranked candidates
object-key insertion order cannot change canonical digest

verification.releaseGate: Do not claim SHIPPED without exact-head CI plus the relevant runtime/UI/onboarding evidence.

explicitNonClaims: No live discovery provider in Phase A
No GitHub enrichment runtime certification yet
No Agent Studio onboarding integration yet
No browser UI or hosted deployment yet
